[[image:Taravin.png|right|thumb|200px|Taravin Sigil]]
'''House Taravin''' is a major House of [[Andor]]. Its [[High Seat]] is [[Dyelin Taravin]].

==Sigil==

The sigil of House Taravin is the owl and oak.

==Activities==

'''[[Succession Wars|Fourth Succession War]]''' - House Taravin was the second House to put its support behind Trakand for the [[Lion Throne]]. This is unusual, since [[Dyelin]] herself had several Houses willing to support her as the next Queen, but did not want the throne.
